goal: Establish deterministic browser E2E plus black-box human-like agent exploration as a first-class frontend acceptance layer so lower-level test PASS cannot hide user-visible workflow failures.
invariants: Lower-level test PASS does not substitute for proof that a user can complete a critical frontend journey through visible UI.
Deterministic Playwright E2E and exploratory browser-agent QA are complementary layers.
The exploratory agent must not use source code, internal APIs, direct database access, DOM/script injection, or hidden implementation knowledge to bypass the user journey.
A user-journey FAIL may block release independently of unit, integration, API, component, or deterministic E2E PASS once the gate reaches blocking maturity.
Every material agent finding must be backed by reproducible evidence and classified as product defect, test/agent flake, or environment/infrastructure issue.
Reproducible exploratory defects should become deterministic Playwright regression coverage where feasible without eliminating exploratory testing.

phases.name: deterministic_critical_journeys
phases.scope: Establish Playwright as the deterministic browser E2E layer for critical journeys; standardize traces, screenshots, terminal-state assertions, and visible-state verification.

phases.name: novice_black_box_exploration
phases.scope: Add a first-time-user browser agent that receives goals instead of selector scripts, uses visible UI only, and emits structured evidence and failure classification.

phases.name: multi_persona_negative_paths
phases.scope: Add technical/operator/error-seeking personas, negative paths, deduplication, and promotion of reproducible findings into deterministic regression tests.

phases.name: blocking_user_journey_gate
phases.scope: Make the machine-evaluable User Journey Validation Gate blocking after flake, rerun, runtime/cost, and environment-classification policies are stable.

definition_of_done: Deterministic Playwright coverage exists for every current critical journey.
A reusable black-box browser-agent runner or adapter exists.
Evidence artifact schemas and persisted run outputs exist.
Failure classification plus bounded retry and timeout policy exist.
Frontend-impacting PR and release routing rules exist.
A machine-evaluable User Journey Validation Gate result exists.
PASS/WARN/FAIL semantics are auditable and documented.
notes: Planning requirement only. This roadmap entry does not claim that Playwright browser E2E, the exploratory agent runner, or the blocking CI gate is already implemented. Existing owner verification, component tests, screenshots, and exact-head evidence remain valid and are extended rather than replaced.
